reason: The hypothesis proposes a novel integration of refractory metal precipitation strengthening (Ta) into MnNiSi-based magnetocaloric alloys to address mechanical weakness, a problem not addressed in the provided MnNiSi literature. It combines the magnetocaloric optimization of MnNiSi (P1, P3) with the precipitation strengthening approach from soft magnetic high-entropy alloys (P7, P10, P14, P17), transferring the concept to a new alloy system with a specific mechanistic justification (preserving covalent bonding for the magnetostructural transition). None of the passages propose or study Ta addition to MnNiSi, nor do they link precipitation strengthening to magnetocaloric performance in this system.
